sources.citation: Caskey, John L. 1954. "Excavations at Lerna, 1952–1953." Hesperia 23 (1): 3–30. https://www.jstor.org/stable/146722
sources.notes: Primary ASCSA preliminary report on early Lerna seasons (Neolithic–Early Helladic exposures). Historical excavation standards.

sources.citation: Caskey, John L. 1955. "Excavations at Lerna, 1954." Hesperia 24 (1): 25–49. https://www.jstor.org/stable/147061
sources.notes: Primary ASCSA preliminary report for the 1954 Lerna season.

sources.citation: Wiencke, Martha H. 2000. Lerna: A Preclassical Site in the Argolid. Volume IV: The Architecture, Stratification, and Pottery of Lerna III. 2 vols. Princeton: American School of Classical Studies at Athens. ISBN 0-87661-226-5.
sources.notes: Primary final-report volumes on Early Helladic II / Lerna III architecture and pottery, including the House of the Tiles.

sources.citation: Blegen, Carl W., John L. Caskey, and Marion Rawson. 1950. Troy: Excavations Conducted by the University of Cincinnati, 1932–1938. Volume I: General Introduction. The First and Second Settlements. Princeton: Princeton University Press for the University of Cincinnati.
sources.notes: Primary Cincinnati Troy final-report vol. I (Troy I–II). Historical methods; absolute chronology must be cross-checked with later Aegean schemes.

sources.citation: Popham, M. R., L. H. Sackett, and P. G. Themelis, eds. 1979–1980. Lefkandi I: The Iron Age. The Settlement and the Cemeteries. BSA Supplementary Volume 11. London: Thames and Hudson for the British School at Athens.
sources.notes: Primary BSA report on Lefkandi Iron Age settlement and cemeteries. Early Iron Age — later than Bronze Age core but key Aegean sequence site already oriented in pack.

sources.citation: Popham, M. R., P. G. Calligas, and L. H. Sackett, eds. 1993. Lefkandi II: The Protogeometric Building at Toumba. BSA Supplementary Volume 22–23. London: British School at Athens.
sources.notes: Primary report on the Protogeometric monumental building ("heroon") at Toumba, Lefkandi.

sources.citation: Atkinson, T. D., et al. 1904. Excavations at Phylakopi in Melos. Society for the Promotion of Hellenic Studies Supplementary Paper No. 4. London: Macmillan / BSA.
sources.notes: Primary BSA Phylakopi excavation volume (Cycladic Bronze Age town). Historical recording; later work revises phasing.

sources.citation: Furumark, Arne. 1941. The Mycenaean Pottery: Analysis and Classification / The Chronology of Mycenaean Pottery. Stockholm: Kungl. Vitterhets Historie och Antikvitets Akademien (2 vols.).
sources.notes: Foundational secondary typology/chronology of Mycenaean pottery. Still cited; absolute dates revised by later radiocarbon/synchronisms.

sources.citation: Manning, Sturt W., et al. 2022. "Second Intermediate Period Date for the Thera (Santorini) Eruption and Historical Implications." PLOS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0274835
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed chronological modeling for Thera eruption. Competing high/low chronologies remain open — treat single calendar-year claims as hypothesis.

sources.citation: Banks, Elizabeth C. 2015. Lerna: A Preclassical Site in the Argolid. Volume VII: The Neolithic Settlement. Princeton: American School of Classical Studies at Athens.
sources.notes: Primary final report on Neolithic settlement at Lerna. Complements Wiencke Lerna IV for earlier strata.

claims.zh: Caskey《Hesperia》预备报告公布勒尔纳 1952–54 季早期发掘。
claims.en: Caskey Hesperia preliminary reports publish early Lerna excavation seasons 1952–54.

claims.zh: Wiencke Lerna IV（2000）正式报告 EH II / Lerna III 建筑与陶器（含砖瓦之屋）。
claims.en: Wiencke Lerna IV (2000) is the final report on EH II / Lerna III architecture and pottery (incl. House of the Tiles).

claims.zh: Blegen 等 Troy I（1950）正式报告辛辛那提大学特洛伊 I–II 层发掘。
claims.en: Blegen et al. Troy I (1950) is the final report on Cincinnati Troy settlements I–II.

claims.zh: Popham 等 Lefkandi I/II 报告勒夫坎迪铁器时代聚落/墓地与图姆巴原几何大建筑。
claims.en: Popham et al. Lefkandi I/II report Lefkandi Iron Age settlement/cemeteries and the Toumba Protogeometric building.

claims.zh: Atkinson 等（1904）公布米洛斯菲拉科皮青铜时代城镇发掘。
claims.en: Atkinson et al. (1904) publish the Bronze Age town excavation at Phylakopi on Melos.

claims.zh: Banks Lerna VII（2015）正式报告勒尔纳新石器聚落。
claims.en: Banks Lerna VII (2015) is the final report on the Neolithic settlement at Lerna.

claims.zh: 锡拉喷发为 LM IB 破坏的唯一主因——年代与因果仍争议，不作定论。
claims.en: That the Thera eruption is the sole cause of LM IB destructions remains contested in date and causation — not a fact verdict.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: eruption–destruction causal link and high/low chronology remain open.

claims.zh: 将锡拉喷发钉死在单一日历年——超出当前模型稳健性，留假说栏。
claims.en: Pinning the Thera eruption to a single calendar year exceeds current model robustness — keep as hypothesis.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: Bayesian ranges are not unique calendar-year facts.

hist_en: Third density pass (2026-10-12 / D-2026-10-12-2) also registers Caskey/Wiencke/Banks Lerna; Blegen Troy I; Popham Lefkandi I/II; Atkinson Phylakopi 1904; Furumark; Manning 2022. Thera=sole LM IB cause and single calendar year stay hypotheses.
